tree.heading: Requirements.—
tree.text: A vessel is a wrecked vessel under this chapter if it—

children.text: was wrecked on a coast of the United States or adjacent waters; and
has undergone repairs in a shipyard in the United States equal to at least 3 times the appraised salvage value of the vessel.

tree.heading: Appraisals.—
tree.text: The Secretary may appoint a board of three appraisers to determine whether a vessel satisfies subsection (a)(2). The costs of the appraisal shall be paid by the owner of the vessel.

The words “The Secretary of Transportation may issue a certificate of documentation with a coastwise endorsement” and “when purchased by a citizen or citizens of the United States” are omitted as unnecessary because section 12112, as revised by the bill, provides the requirements for a wrecked vessel to obtain a coastwise endorsement. In subsection (c)(1), the words “or her possessions” are omitted as unnecessary because of the definition of “United States” in chapter 1 of the revised title.
